execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."course_spots" (
  "course_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" character varying(255),
  "note_en" character varying(255),
  "sort_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "spot_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "stay_minutes" int4,
  "walk_minutes_from_previous" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "course_spots_sort_order_positive_90621c4e" CHECK (sort_order > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."courses" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "description_en" text,
  "duration_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "duration_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lens_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(150),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "courses_duration_minutes_positive_4cddc355" CHECK (duration_minutes > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "courses_duration_type_check_90a23ba8" CHECK ("duration_type" IN ('MINUTES_30_60', 'HOURS_1_2', 'HOURS_2_3', 'HALF_DAY'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."events" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "description_en" text,
  "end_at" timestamptz(6),
  "external_url" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "location" character varying(200),
  "location_en" character varying(200),
  "start_at" timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "title_en" character varying(200),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lens_nearby_spots" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lens_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nearby_spot_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "priority" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "recommendation_reason" character varying(255),
  "recommendation_reason_en" character varying(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lenses" (
  "companion" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "description_en" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "interest" text NOT NULL,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "title_en" character varying(150),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "lenses_companion_check_384aa1d3" CHECK ("companion" IN ('SOLO', 'FRIENDS', 'COUPLE', 'SMALL_CHILDREN', 'FAMILY')),
  CONSTRAINT "lenses_interest_check_d61f7203" CHECK ("interest" IN ('PANDA', 'SEASON', 'PLAY', 'PHOTO', 'RELAX'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."nearby_spots" (
  "address" character varying(255),
  "address_en" character varying(255),
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "description_en" text,
  "external_url" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(150),
  "opening_hours" character varying(255),
  "slug" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "nearby_spots_category_check_3b9369dc" CHECK ("category" IN ('CAFE', 'RESTAURANT', 'KIDS', 'SIGHTSEEING', 'SHOPPING', 'RELAX', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."news" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "body_en" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "published_at" timestamptz(6),
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "title_en" character varying(200),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."red_pandas" (
  "birth_date" date,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "description_en" text,
  "father_id" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "mother_id" uuid,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(100),
  "sex" character varying(20),
  "source_url" text,
  "spot_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."seasons" (
  "description" text,
  "description_en" text,
  "end_day" int2,
  "end_month" int2 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(100),
  "season_group" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "start_day" int2,
  "start_month" int2 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "seasons_end_month_range_83d8a391" CHECK (end_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12),
  CONSTRAINT "seasons_season_group_check_8ddc52f9" CHECK ("season_group" IN ('SPRING', 'SUMMER', 'AUTUMN', 'WINTER')),
  CONSTRAINT "seasons_start_month_range_bbc43c89" CHECK (start_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."spots" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "description_en" text,
  "external_url" text,
  "fee_text" character varying(100),
  "fee_text_en" character varying(100),
  "has_rest_area" bool,
  "has_toilet" bool,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(150),
  "opening_hours" character varying(255),
  "slug" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "stay_minutes" int4,
  "stroller_accessible" bool,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "spots_category_check_386717d1" CHECK ("category" IN ('ZOO', 'PLAYGROUND', 'GARDEN', 'FLOWER', 'VIEW', 'REST', 'FOOD', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."todays_finds" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "description_en" text,
  "effect_type" text,
  "end_at" timestamptz(6),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lens_id" uuid,
  "season_id" uuid,
  "spot_id" uuid,
  "start_at" timestamptz(6),
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "title_en" character varying(150),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "todays_finds_effect_type_check_352072ad" CHECK ("effect_type" IN ('FLOWER', 'LEAF', 'AUTUMN', 'SNOW', 'NONE'))
)
